voice.name: Henri - French-American Narrator
voice.why: Bastien Girard has run the town hall since before the evacuation and wants the day to go smoothly. Henri is a warm, mature, classy French-accented man: an official who is formal but kind, a long way from the harbour master's rasp and the clerk's flat seriousness. Stability 0.55 and speed 0.95 for a man who has made this speech before.

greet.text: Ah, a face I do not know yet. Bastien Girard, mayor. Forgive the mess, the whole town is busy with the day.

day.text: Three years since the first families walked in from the dark. We lay trestles in the square, we light candles, we say thank you. Everyone remembers that night a little differently, and the town must hold all of it.

errand.text: Then take what the square still lacks, and come back when it is done. I will not forget it.

replies.offer: Can I help with the preparations?
